items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Red Garland. I caught that band live at a club in the Village in New York on an occasion many years ago.

ctx.x: Red Garland. I caught that band live at a club in the Village in New York on an occasion many years ago. I can never forget that they would play about an hour-and-ten-or-fifteen-minute set. Then they would be offstage for about forty-five minutes. As soon as they came offstage for their break, Coltrane would go into the basement area and practice until time to go back onto the bandstand, which meant he was literally playing all night long without a break.
